run_gtest_output_test: run the googletest output test to compare actual output against the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a new golden file by running all gtest commands and writing normalized output
normalize_test_output: normalize googletest output by removing file locations, stack traces, and time info
remove_stack_traces: remove all stack trace details from googletest program output using regex substitution
remove_matching_tests: remove output of specified test cases matching a regex pattern from test output
